description: Dataset of Natural Disaster Cases of Chongqing Transmission Lines Corresponding with ERA5 Meteorological Data (2014-2024) 融合ERA5气象资料的2014-2024年重庆输电线路自然灾害数据集 is a data set deposited in ScienceDB (Science Data Bank) by its authors Wang Yuanmou (重庆市气象服务中心). This dataset selects power grid safety accident data in Chongqing caused by weather factors from 2014 to 2024 and classifies into lightning, wind and icing disasters (Data source: Chongqing Electric Power Research Institute, State Grid Chongqing Electric Power Co). Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 1532179 bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-sciencedb-repository.
